settings.heading:
The thobe.
The abaya.
The koofi.
settings.copy: Maison Safa is a small house for these three. Cloth we can name. Seams you can trust. Cut to order in Riyadh, finished to the same pattern in London.
settings.image_alt: An ivory thobe, a black abaya, and a cream koofi in the atelier.

settings.label: Cloth
settings.text: Named mills. Cotton, crepe, wool, linen.

settings.label: Cut
settings.text: Numbered sizes, tried on a standing form.

settings.label: Time
settings.text: Two to three weeks, cut to order.

settings.label: Repair
settings.text: Seams and cuffs, for the life of the cloth.

settings.handles: qasr, safa, madina, marjan, noor, atlas

settings.label: Thobes
settings.title: For the long day
settings.copy: Ankle-length and straight through the body. Cotton and linen for heat, wool when the evening asks for it.
settings.image_alt: The Qasr, an ivory thobe, hanging on a walnut hanger.

settings.label: Abayas
settings.title: An honest fall
settings.copy: Outer layers with a clean shoulder and a sleeve that stays out of the way. Open, or closed with covered buttons.
settings.image_alt: The Safa, a black open abaya, hanging in the atelier.

settings.label: Koofis
settings.title: Close to the head
settings.copy: The koofi — our name for the kufi cap. Crochet, knit, linen, and wool. Nothing with a brim.
settings.image_alt: The Madina, a cream crocheted koofi, resting on limestone.

settings.quote: We would rather make fewer things, and mend them.
